layers.name: Global Commons registry
layers.description: Commons in the Global Commons registry that have a place on the map, each with its step on the rules ladder (1 no rules, 2 weak rules, 3 rules that don't pay out). Points marked indicative are candidate areas, not boundaries or claims.
attribution: Global Commons Initiative, Hub Culture and contributors (CC BY 4.0)

layers.name: Open Blue Carbon Registry sites
layers.description: Mangrove, tidal marsh and seagrass sites in the Open Blue Carbon Registry, with their class (established or emerging) and status (registered, mapped, evidenced, verified, credit-ready). Points marked indicative are candidate sites listed from public records, not boundaries or claims. The registry issues no carbon credits.
attribution: Open Blue Carbon Registry, Global Commons Initiative, Hub Culture and contributors (CC BY 4.0)
